card.title: VILLERS-BOCAGE
card.text: The Battle of Villers-Bocage was a 1944 tank battle between German and British forces.
card.flavorText: The Battle of Villers-Bocage occurred on June 13th, 1944, shortly after the D-Day landings in Normandy, and was part of the larger Battle for Caen. This intense tank battle involved British and German forces, with German commander Michael Wittmann leading a counterattack using Tiger tanks against British armored units. Wittmann achieved early success by ambushing British forces and destroying several tanks. The battle resulted in heavy casualties on both sides and in the retreat of the British forces. This allowed the Germans to take control of the town for a brief period.
